description: Run one SQL statement that changes data (insert/update/delete) or the schema. Returns { rowCount, columns, rows, rowsTruncated, snapshots }, or for DDL { changeId, snapshots } (logged like apply_schema_change). At most 100 RETURNING rows (10 MB) come back: when rowsTruncated is true the write still happened in full and rowCount counts every row. An update/delete touching more than 100 rows (or inside a WITH clause), a truncate or a drop first saves a 7-day snapshot of the table. EXPLAIN ANALYZE of a write is refused. One statement per call; time limit per statement = the plan's (Free 5 s, Pro 30 s).

allowWithoutSnapshot.description: Go ahead even if a safety snapshot can't be taken (cap reached). Only when the person agrees.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

description.description: For schema changes: what and why (logged).

params.description: Values for $1, $2 … (strings, numbers, booleans, null, or JSON for json/jsonb columns).

sql.description: Exactly one SQL statement. Use $1, $2 … for values.

name: execute
